title: MC2 Material Manifest
description: Offline cook manifest for GPU material table. Each entry maps a material slot to KTX2 texture paths and scalar parameters. Slot indices match MaterialHandle::index() at runtime.

version.description: Schema version. Bump when any field is added, removed, or reinterpreted.

comment.description: Optional human note. Not consumed by the cook tool.

materials.description: Ordered list. materials[N] cooks into MaterialGpu table slot N.

slot.description: Expected slot index. Cook tool validates materials[i].slot == i (no gaps, no reorder).

name.description: Human-readable debug label. Not stored in MaterialGpu; surfaced in cook errors.

albedo_ktx2.description: Path to albedo/diffuse KTX2 (required). Relative to manifest file. Cooks into MaterialGpu.albedoTex.

normal_ktx2.description: Tangent-space normal map KTX2. null = kMaterialTexAbsent; kMatFlagNormalMap NOT set. Cooks into MaterialGpu.normalTex.

metallic_roughness_ktx2.description: R=AO G=roughness B=metalness KTX2. null = kMaterialTexAbsent; kMatFlagMetallicRoughness NOT set. Cooks into MaterialGpu.metallicRoughnessTex.

emissive_ktx2.description: Emissive color KTX2. null = kMaterialTexAbsent; kMatFlagEmissive NOT set. Cooks into MaterialGpu.emissiveTex.

base_color_factor.description: Albedo tint/brightness multiplier [0,1]. Cooks into MaterialGpu.baseColorFactor.

metallic_factor.description: Metalness override/multiplier [0,1]. When metallic_roughness_ktx2 is present, multiplies the B channel. Cooks into MaterialGpu.metallicFactor.

roughness_factor.description: Roughness override/multiplier [0,1]. When metallic_roughness_ktx2 is present, multiplies the G channel. Cooks into MaterialGpu.roughnessFactor.

flags.description: Material flags. Cook tool derives MaterialGpu.flags from these booleans.

alpha_test.description: kMatFlagAlphaTest: discard fragments with alpha < 0.5. Cook tool validates albedo has alpha channel.

double_sided.description: kMatFlagDoubleSided: disable back-face culling for this material.

window.description: kMatFlagWindow: hot-color magic applies; sun/ambient lighting skipped (mirrors inst.flags bit 1).
